title: Tess of the d'Urbervilles
author: Thomas Hardy
summary: A poor Wessex girl sent to claim kinship with a wealthy family is wronged by a man there, and later struggles to build a life with the idealistic man she loves as her past catches up.
readIf: you like slow Victorian tragedies with strong landscapes and a critique of social judgment.
skipIf: you want a happy ending or a lively pace.
